title: Arriving 'gods' will be received as saviours, leading to Armageddon

tellings.quote: And that that group will be received as the gods returning to the earth.

plain: A group of beings will one day arrive and be welcomed as "the gods returning to the earth", greeted as saviours, and that welcome will lead to Armageddon, according to the filmmaker Tim Alberino. He tells Michels this as his own reading, drawing on the King James Version of the Bible, published in 1611, and on a work called Birthright. If he is right, humanity's greatest disaster would arrive looking like a rescue.
